info.title: OctoGraph.Cli
info.description: Local code knowledge graph CLI, API bridge, MCP server, and packaged web portal for AI-assisted repository navigation.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze a repository and register it.

options.name: --force
options.description: Force analysis even if existing state is present. [default: False]

options.name: --skills
options.description: Write OctoGraph skill files after analysis. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-agents-md
options.description: Do not write AGENTS.md. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-git
options.description: Skip git metadata checks. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print verbose progress. [default: False]

options.name: --worker-timeout
options.description: Worker timeout in seconds.

commands.name: index
commands.description: Index repositories and register them.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List registered repositories.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show repository index status.

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Clear repository cache and logs.

options.name: --graph
options.description: Also delete the persisted graph directory. [default: False]

options.name: --all
options.description: Clean all registered repositories and remove them from the registry. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Required with --all. [default: False]

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Unregister a repository.

options.name: --delete-local-state
options.description: Delete the repository .octograph directory. [default: False]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check local OctoGraph runtime health.

options.name: --dev
options.description: Also check contributor tools such as Node.js and npm. [default: False]

commands.name: query
commands.description: Query analyzed repository symbols.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Search mode: lexical, semantic, or hybrid. Omit to use existing graph query behavior.

commands.name: context
commands.description: Show context for a symbol or node.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

options.name: --pack
options.description: Produce citation-aware packed context. [default: False]

options.name: --budget
options.description: Maximum characters for packed context. [default: 4000]

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Symbol name or graph node id.

commands.name: impact
commands.description: Show impact for a symbol or node.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Symbol name or graph node id.

commands.name: route-map
commands.description: List enriched API routes for a repository.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

commands.name: tool-map
commands.description: List enriched tool nodes for a repository.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

commands.name: shape-check
commands.description: Show response shape information for a route, API, or shape target.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Symbol name or graph node id.

commands.name: api-impact
commands.description: Show graph impact with enriched route/API context.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Symbol name or graph node id.

commands.name: group
commands.description: Manage multi-repository groups.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a repository group.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a registered repository to a group.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a repository entry from a group.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List repository groups.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show group status.

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Refresh group contracts from indexed repositories.

commands.name: contracts
commands.description: List cached group contracts.

commands.name: query
commands.description: Search across repositories in a group.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum group results. [default: 50]

commands.name: detect-changes
commands.description: List files changed since the last index.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

commands.name: cypher
commands.description: Run a read-only graph query.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

commands.name: rename
commands.description: Rename an identifier in indexed source files.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

options.name: --scope
options.description: Limit rename to paths containing this text.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Write OctoGraph agent and MCP setup files.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

options.name: --target
options.description: Agent target: codex, claude, github-copilot, or antigravity.

options.name: --global-config
options.description: Write global editor MCP configuration. [default: False]

options.name: --hooks
options.description: Write editor hook files. [default: False]

commands.name: augment
commands.description: Add OctoGraph context to existing documentation files.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

commands.name: wiki
commands.description: Generate local repository wiki files.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

options.name: --model
options.description: Optional prose provider label.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Optional prose provider base URL.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing wiki files. [default: False]

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Publish graph artifacts into .octograph/publish.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Evaluate repository graph quality checks.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

options.name: --query
options.description: Query to evaluate.

options.name: --expect
options.description: Expected text in query results.

commands.name: diagnostics
commands.description: Write a repository diagnostics report.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository path or registered name containing the persisted OctoGraph graph.

commands.name: portal
commands.description: Start or manage the packaged OctoGraph web portal.

options.name: --check
options.description: Only check portal runtime prerequisites. [default: False]

options.name: --foreground
options.description: Run the portal backend in the current console. [default: False]

options.name: --url
options.description: Explicit backend URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:5013.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the packaged portal process status.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the packaged portal backend started by OctoGraph.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Start the OctoGraph HTTP API bridge and web UI.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Start the OctoGraph MCP stdio host.
